modules.module_title: Lay truck or sub truck cables install and connectorize as per designed route

pcs.pc_description: prepare a plan for laying cables for single way/two way with reverse path as per the designed route provided by the supervisor
identify the various types of cables Types: sub-trunk, access cable and fiber optics
calculate the height and length of the pole/tree before the laying the cables
create a requirement list and procure the materials
test the line using a line tester
ensure to lay the cables on a low-tension line
support the trunk/sub-trunk cable lines evenly about the circumference with messenger wires without crushing the cable
clip the cables using clipping wire at a distance of 1 meter throughout the trunk/subtrunk line
keep the cable away from heating vents and water heaters
maintain a minimum height of 12-16 feet for trunks
carry out laying of cables as per the designed route like from pole to pole or tree to tree, etc. by climbing up the ladder safely
adhere to all safety measures while working on electrical poles Safety measures: Wear safety belts, shock proof shoes, helmets, goggles, and gloves
keep a loop of 3-5 meters cable on every pole after 80 meters
bend the cable as per manufacturers bending specification to avoid shorts, cable's impedance and signal loss

modules.module_title: Carry out installation and connectorization of actives and passives

pcs.pc_description: carry out proper fitting of the enclosure box for housing (actives/passives)
keep a small cable loop at the input and output of the amplifier
check the box have provision for locking
inspect that the box is painted with proper LCO code
ensure the RF coaxial cable connectors have a characteristic impedance matching that of the cable
check proper connectorization is established by using standard connecters and right kinds of tools
connectorize the trunk cables, input and output of the amplifiers and install passives (Tap off/Splitters) as per the design diagram
create testing points at the input and output
ensure proper torque is given to all the connecters

modules.module_title: Carry out balancing and commissioning of amplifier

modules.module_title: Lay optical fibre cables for multi play network

pcs.pc_description: check the feasibility of laying trunk and sub- trunk routes from the fibre to the home (FTTH) distribution network plan received from route designer
create a requirement list and carry out procurement of the materials
install network management system (NMS) modem at each node to ensure the node is functional 24x7
ensure to carry the right of way (ROW) letter given by the concerned authority for laying the cables
lay the cables as per the requirement plan using proper messenger and clipping wires
prepare as build diagram (ABD) of the complete fibre trunk route, poles used, locations of joint closures, splitters and other passives by marking on a google map with all physical locations
ensure a loop of 2-3 meters are maintained on every alternative poles
check a proper bend radius is maintained as per manufacturer's specifications
use all the safety measures related to work
maintain a minimum height of 12 feet for the trunk line
install passive splitters as per design diagram and requirement at multiple locations on the trunk line
ensure proper fitment of joint closure on the pole using the clamp
use drip loop of fibre cable at the input and output of joint closure
ensure to maintain a split ratio for creating customer ports from one fibre Split ratio: 1:8, 1:16, 1:24, 1:32, etc.
prepare the fibre cables for jointing as per the colour code
carry out work in a moisture free environment
ensure the fibre cables are spliced as per the design diagram by optical fibre splicer
clean dust particles on the fibre by using disinfectant solution, e.g., iso-propyl solution
splice the fibre cable by maintaining the standard splicing parameters like attenuation in dB per splice
use proper tools for fibre cable laying and splicing Tools: Plier, spanner, screw driver, line tester, cleaver, splicing machine

modules.module_title: Carry out commissioning and installation of multi play network

pcs.pc_description: carry out testing of network by energising the fibre core at the backend using a laser source
test the power at various splitter output points using an optical power meter
ensure the available powers at all the splitter output points are as per standard for driving the customer premise equipment (CPE)
check the feed feasibility and amount of drop cable required as per customers request

carry all the materials like drop cable, joint closure, modem, patch cord, multi play ready optical network unit (ONU), LAN cable, RF cable, set top box (STB), and high definition multiple insertion (HDMI) cable
connect the drop cable to the nearest available splitter port of the joint closure in the house
ensure the output of the joint closure is fed to the optical network unit using a patch cord
carry out signal level testing using an optical power meter at the end of the patch cord as per standard to drive the customer premise equipment
connect the radio frequency (RF) to the set top box for establishing signal for television network
use the LAN cable to connect and configure the WIFI router
ensure the WIFI router is authorised as per the plan opted by the customer through customer provisioning system at the backend
escalate customer issues and problems that are unresolved at field level
record all the optical parameters, RF parameters for forward and reverse path for final audit and closure of the activity
install and configure the modem, and connect it to the laptops/ desktops
test the signal levels and other technical parameters required for cable modem
describe the operations and functions of cable modem to the customers
explain the preventive maintenance procedures to keep the connection up and running
clean the work site after the work is complete, and remove all the wastes from the site
ensure the customer signs off the installation report along with the customer feedback form
update installation status to the back office after satisfactory closure of the work order
